links.outcome: Hallucination frequency of LLMs answering questions about the WHO TB mutation catalogue
links.effect: DeepSeek R1 exhibited some hallucinations despite high accuracy on focused datasets; Perplexity AI had a higher frequency of hallucinations; Gemini 2.5 Pro avoided hallucinations most often.
links.quote: DeepSeek R1 excelled in applying grading rules to novel mutations and showed high accuracy in focused datasets, but exhibited some hallucinations.

unlisted_practices: Comparing multiple LLMs to select a model for a clinical knowledgebase assistant
Providing antibiotic-specific catalogue tables versus the full catalogue as input to improve retrieval accuracy

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs (Gemini, ChatGPT, Perplexity, DeepSeek) on tasks navigating and querying the WHO TB Mutation Catalogue without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
